chunks: From what al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd narrated from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from him, who said:

Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام said to me regarding the qunut in the fajr prayer: If you wish, then perform qunut, and if you wish, then do not perform qunut. And he said: when there is taqiyyah, then do not perform qunut, and I adhere to this.

key_terms.أَتَقَلَّدُ: I adopt or hold myself to this ruling
key_terms.تَقِيَّةٌ: dissimulation or precautionary concealment due to fear or sensitive circumstances

ai.seo_question: Is qunut in fajr prayer obligatory, and what is the ruling when there is taqiyyah?
ai.summary: This hadith states that qunut in the fajr prayer is optional. It also clarifies that when taqiyyah is involved, qunut should be omitted, indicating a legal concession in practice under such circumstances.
